When I tell him to clean up immediately, he laughs and says, “it’s granite, it’s indestructible!” This all annoyed me so much. I’m annoyed just typing it. AITA? All I want is for him to respect my things. He knows that I hate when he does this stuff but he shouts and yells and calls me over critical every time I try to explain it to him. I’m at my wit’s end.
